candidate_workaround: Separate staging, exact staged review, and receipt staging; give the staged reviewer a timeout comfortably above its measured path-count runtime and report each exit independently.
failure_signature: A combined fixed-point wrapper exited without a diagnostic, then the decomposed 159-path staged review exceeded a 30-second tool envelope even though it was near completion.
recurrence_guard: For staged surfaces above 100 paths, never combine all lifecycle steps in one opaque wrapper and budget at least twice the measured exact-review runtime.
rollback: Stop the opaque or timed-out wrapper, infer no pass from partial output, preserve the failure, and retry only the exact read-only stage with a larger bound.
scope_boundary: Bounded same-owner Git-index review recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, privacy-complete, security-complete, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Decompose and time-budget exact staged reviews
trigger_preconditions: exact Git-index manifest and privacy scan
